name: w60_bc_a3
_comment: Beam cap A3: w60_bc_a2 with the probe taps starting 15 s after the spray stops (about 38 s into the recording) instead of 4 s: if a refused probe costs its 20 s reload, it fires at the tap near 78 s, mid-way through the spokes expiring; if it waits for an empty table, near 88 s; if it fires at the first free slot, near 74 s.
